title: Friend's medium reading channels his late sister
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Friend's medium reading channels his late sister, about recent at not stated, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he was saying that he saw a medium and the medium immediately started kind of ragging on him the way that his sister did.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove about a friend whose sister had died. According to Michels, the friend went to a medium, a person who claims to speak with the dead, and the medium straight away began teasing him in exactly the way his sister used to. Michels shares it as a hint that something of a person may survive death.
